text:
We went to Tbilisi for like 6 days and we used an agency. I am usually very independent and have no problems organizing things like this, but while it was only us and witnesses, I wanted also a photoshoot and makeup and to book a wedding hall etc and it was honestly too much hassle in my opinion. It costed us about 1000 dollars and included documents with delivery to the hotel when needed (translations, apostille), makeup, hair, flowers, wedding hall, photos in the wedding hall, location in the city and location in the mountains, plus transport on the day of the wedding.
The agency was awesome and girls worked hard so we can just enjoy, also wedding hall was beautiful, they present you wine and you can have a first dance. All together this "quick" wedding turned out very nice and photos are awesome.
In Haifa they accepted the certificate in english.
